subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is true with regard to preference given in most Five - Year Plans in India?

options.text: Extensive Promotion of private sector entrepreneurship
Investment in basic and heavy industries

solution:
The correct answer is __**Investment in basic and heavy industries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Most Five-Year Plans in India have emphasized the importance of **investment in basic and heavy industries** to build a strong industrial base.
 
• These investments were crucial for achieving **self-sufficiency in industrial production** and reducing dependence on foreign imports.
 
• The focus on heavy industries was aimed at improving the **infrastructure, creating jobs, and fostering technological advancements** within the country.
